commits.body: Mechanical setup for the trusted-kernel experiment brief, recorded in llm-dlc/loops/in-the-loop-trusted-kernel-experiment-brief-setup.md with notes for the domain agent. The Guava 33.4.8-jre jar and its runtime graph were checked against Maven Central's SHA-1s and their signatures in a keyring of this setup's own (11 of 11); the Ints, IntsMethodsForWeb and Longs class entries were extracted, and their digests equal those in examples 336 and 346's records; the release commit f06690fa was checked out and its sources equal the signed sources jar. CaDiCaL 1.9.5 (rel-1.9.5, the same solver the checker's cadical crate bundles, apart from Windows portability code) and cake_lpr 033aad53 were fetched and built, and an LRAT round trip on made-up formulas showed cake_lpr accepts a good proof and rejects damaged or foreign ones, always with exit 0. The installed Lean v4.35.0 and v4.36.0 toolchains were checked file by file against their release archives' GitHub digests. The checker was built at this head. A JVM probe on Temurin 21.0.13 replayed the brief's release inputs (first match, empty, singleton, extrema, longs differing by 2^32): 14 of 14 as the brief says, arrays unchanged. No claims, examples, adapters or checker code were written, no verifier ran on a claim, and no job was needed; the Stage 1 baselines are left to the domain agent.
